supporting_article_titles: Omnissaが「Elara」を発表 AIエージェントの暴走を防ぐ“実行前の権限レイヤー”とは
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Enterprise AI/agent actions can be evaluated against identity, device, app, policy, freeze and dependency context before execution, with approval routing and replayable evidence.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: AI-agent and automated change authorization before consequential enterprise actions
raw_opportunities.target_customer: enterprises deploying AI agents and automation across heterogeneous IT systems
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Prevent unauthorized or contextually unsafe agent actions while preserving an auditable approval chain.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Permissions and change controls are fragmented by system; agents can act at machine speed across boundaries and shadow AI is difficult to govern.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Vendor-neutral web approval/control plane that registers agents, maps policies and high-impact actions, routes approvals, and records decision evidence.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A lightweight AI Action Approval Desk for organizations that need human/policy gates before high-impact agent actions.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Agentic systems are moving from assistance to execution, creating a new pre-action authorization and evidence requirement.

evidence_notes.source_fact: Omnissa announced Elara beta with shadow-AI discovery, guardrails, pre-action change control and audit-ready evidence.
evidence_notes.inference: A narrower workflow product can target organizations that do not need a full endpoint-management authority layer.

supporting_article_titles: 電通総研、AIエージェント搭載の安全保障貿易管理ソリューション「GREENLIGHT」
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: AI-assisted export-control classification can combine regulatory search, preliminary classification, evidence and approval history; a Japanese proof of concept reduced request-to-preliminary-decision time by up to 97%.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: Export-control classification request → regulation/product evidence gathering → preliminary determination → expert approval → audit record
raw_opportunities.target_customer: manufacturers and technology exporters handling controlled goods, software or technical data
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Turn repeated export-control classification requests into traceable, reviewable cases.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Regulations change, product evidence is scattered, specialist review is slow, and rationale/approval histories are difficult to reuse.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Case-management portal for intake, rule/evidence checklist, draft determination, human approval, reusable rationale and audit history.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: An export-control case desk that structures classification evidence and approvals instead of leaving them in email and spreadsheets.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Tighter economic-security/export-control regimes increase the frequency and cost of defensible classification decisions.

evidence_notes.quantitative_signal: Dentsu Soken reports up to 97% reduction in workflow time in a domestic-company PoC.
evidence_notes.boundary: MVP supports workflow/evidence; it must not autonomously provide legally authoritative classifications.

raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Procurement assistance linked to warehouse visibility can redirect demand toward already-held inventory and reduce working-capital needs.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: Purchase request → contract/catalog search → warehouse stock check → reuse/transfer-or-buy decision → procurement
raw_opportunities.target_customer: multi-site manufacturers, miners, logistics operators and industrial groups with distributed stores/warehouses
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Avoid buying an item that already exists elsewhere in the organization's inventory.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Buyers struggle to navigate contracts and fragmented warehouse stock, causing off-contract purchases, duplicate buying and excess working capital.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Request intake and stock-first decision workflow that searches normalized warehouse inventory and contracts, suggests reuse/transfer, and records avoided purchases.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A Stock-Before-Buy procurement desk that checks distributed inventory before a new purchase is approved.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Agentic search and enterprise data access make cross-warehouse stock discovery usable inside procurement workflows.

evidence_notes.source_fact: Fortescue says warehouse visibility shifted users toward existing inventory and reduced working capital.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: The workflow is transferable to factories, suppliers, warehouses and logistics operators in the Lüleburgaz–Çorlu–Çerkezköy industrial corridor; local presence still requires fresh validation before assigning Lüleburgaz scope.

supporting_article_titles: 정부 지원 GPU 70%, 가동률 50% 미만…AI 자원 관리 공백
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Publicly supported GPU allocations show large under-utilization, making allocation, utilization evidence, reclamation and re-assignment a measurable operations problem.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: GPU request → allocation → workload scheduling → utilization tracking → justification/reclaim/reallocation
raw_opportunities.target_customer: shared GPU programs, universities, accelerators, AI labs and organizations operating pooled accelerators
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Show whether scarce accelerator capacity is actually being used and reassign it when justified.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Allocation and real utilization are managed separately; low-use reasons, workload stage and reclaim/reallocation decisions are hard to audit.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Web ledger for allocation, workload milestones, utilization imports, idle exceptions, reclaim alerts and reallocation decisions.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A GPU Allocation Utilization Ledger for shared compute programs that need evidence before renewing or reclaiming capacity.
raw_opportunities.why_now: In Korea, 443 of 620 allocated GPUs in 2025 and 350 of 478 in 2026 were reported below 50% utilization, while AI infrastructure budgets continue expanding.

evidence_notes.quantitative_signal: 71.5% of 2025 and 73.2% of 2026 allocated GPUs in the cited support program were below 50% utilization.
evidence_notes.caveat: The ministry said utilization varies by research stage and low utilization alone does not establish waste.

supporting_article_titles: 製造業のPSIRT運用体制整備で協業、欧州CRA対応などを支援
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: EU CRA reporting obligations turn post-market product vulnerability handling into a time-bound, cross-company evidence and notification workflow for manufacturers.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: Vulnerability intake → affected-product/SBOM assessment → severity/CRA applicability → authority/customer/supply-chain notification → remediation evidence
raw_opportunities.target_customer: manufacturers selling connected or software-enabled products into the EU
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Coordinate and prove CRA vulnerability handling across products and suppliers.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: SBOM/SCA findings, supplier responses, deadlines, notifications and remediation evidence are fragmented across security tools, email and spreadsheets.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: CRA/PSIRT case manager with product registry, deadline rules, evidence checklist, supplier requests, notification drafts and audit trail.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A CRA PSIRT Case Desk that turns vulnerability reports into deadline-driven evidence and notification workflows.
raw_opportunities.why_now: CRA vulnerability/incident reporting obligations began applying in September 2026, increasing operational urgency for manufacturers.

evidence_notes.source_fact: Industry support offerings explicitly target PSIRT setup/operation and CRA readiness as reporting requirements begin.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Connected-product and machinery suppliers in the Trakya industrial corridor could face the same EU-export workflow; concrete local company evidence is not present in assigned material.

supporting_article_titles: 美国加州《反机器人老板》法案生效，禁止完全依赖 AI 解雇或惩戒员工
加州州长纽森签署法案 禁止雇主仅靠AI解雇或惩罚员工
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: California employers face new human-review and worker-protection requirements around consequential AI-supported employment decisions.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: AI employment signal → proposed discipline/termination → human review → notice/explanation → decision evidence
raw_opportunities.target_customer: California employers using algorithmic or AI systems in workforce management
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Prove that consequential employment decisions received required human oversight and notice.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: AI recommendations may be generated in separate HR tools without a consistent human-review record, notice packet or evidence trail.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Decision-review queue that captures AI input, assigns a human reviewer, requires rationale/checklist completion, generates notices and preserves evidence.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A Human Review Ledger for AI-assisted employment decisions in California.
raw_opportunities.why_now: California enacted worker-AI protections on September 30, 2026, creating immediate compliance workflow changes.

evidence_notes.scope_note: Commercially jurisdiction-specific even though the software can be delivered globally; discovery schema lacks a US/California scope tier, so Dünya is used.

supporting_article_titles: 実運用へ広がるAI活用、「SRE」にも変化――67％が“AIの監視”を重要視
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Production AI shifts reliability work from infrastructure-only observability toward monitoring model/agent behavior, decisions and policy compliance.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: AI production event → behavior/decision telemetry → anomaly or policy signal → owner triage → corrective action → evidence
raw_opportunities.target_customer: software teams operating production AI features or agents without a mature AI observability platform
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Track operational AI failures and policy-relevant behavior as actionable incidents rather than scattered logs.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Traditional uptime/latency monitoring does not capture agent decisions, outcome quality or governance context; ownership and incident follow-up are fragmented.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: AI incident register that ingests lightweight events, classifies behavior/policy failures, assigns owners, tracks remediation and produces reliability reports.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: An AI Reliability Incident Desk for small platform teams that need structured human follow-up around model and agent failures.
raw_opportunities.why_now: A 2026 SRE survey reported 67% of respondents consider monitoring AI behavior important as AI moves into production.

evidence_notes.survey_population: 919 managers/supervisors directly involved in SRE, platform engineering or IT operations at enterprises with annual revenue above $500M; fielded Oct 2025–Jan 2026.
evidence_notes.inference: The raw opportunity narrows enterprise observability into a simpler incident workflow rather than recreating a telemetry platform.
